subject: Unexpected credit on AWS invoice / seller tax-tag mismatch
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@vantagesystems.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Support <aws-marketplace-support@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected marketplace credit applied to August invoice - evidence attached

Hi Hannah,

We just received our August AWS Marketplace invoice and noticed an unexplained negative line (credit) of $28,430 applied to our August payout. The credit knocks our expected payout down significantly and the invoice notes "VAT adjustment - seller tagging". We don't have any recent refunds or returns, and our internal ledger shows full usage for August.

Attached: vantage_invoice_aug2028.pdf (redacted line items)

Could you help confirm whether this credit originated from AWS (seller tax reclassification) or from a downstream settlement change? If it is AWS, we need the audit trail so we can reconcile with our finance team and external auditors.

Thanks — we have a monthly board close next week and need an answer by end of week.

Best,
Elena Morales
VP Finance, Vantage Systems
elena@vantagesystems.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Support <aws-marketplace-support@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Sep 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Unexpected marketplace credit applied to August invoice - evidence attached

Folks — forwarding Vantage's note. They attached a PDF of the invoice showing a VAT-related credit. Internal ask below:

1) Jonas: please confirm whether this credit reduced our payable balance to the seller (Vantage) or whether it was an upstream fee reclassification on the marketplace side that created a negative line on their invoice.
2) Marissa: can you check August settlement reports for any "VAT adjustment" flags or seller tax-tag changes for VG-4532?
3) Logan: if this is a marketplace-generated reclassification, we need to know how that maps to our revenue recognition buckets and whether a reversal needs to hit our payout ledger.
4) Rishi: flag any contractual risk if the credit was applied without seller consent.

I cc'd AWS support because Elena asked us to loop them in. Please reply-all with short bullets — Elena needs clarity for a board close.

Attached: forward_stub.txt

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Finance Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Sep 2028 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Unexpected marketplace credit applied to August invoice - evidence attached

Quick read: I pulled the settlement export for the August payout window. There's an entry labelled "VAT reclassification - Seller tax tag corrected" for the Vantage seller id (VG-4532) dated 2028-08-29. The amount matches the credit on Elena's PDF.

Action items for ops: can Marissa confirm whether that tax-tag correction reflects a change to tax jurisdiction/merchant-entity mapping or if AWS applied an auto-correction based on marketplace tax tooling? If it was an auto-correction, we should also get the audit log from AWS.

Also: Logan — if the credit reduced payout to Vantage, we need a journal entry to move the amount out of "pending payouts" and into a short-term payable until resolved.

-Jonas

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 06 Sep 2028 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Unexpected marketplace credit applied to August invoice - evidence attached

On Tue, Sep 5, 2028 at 2:20 PM Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Quick read: I pulled the settlement export for the August payout window. There's an entry labelled "VAT reclassification - Seller tax tag corrected" for the Vantage seller id (VG-4532) dated 2028-08-29. The amount matches the credit on Elena's PDF.

I checked the marketplace ledger and the seller mapping. Short summary:
- On 2028-08-27 we received an automated tax-tag correction from AWS that moved transactions initially attributed to VG-4532 (US entity) to VG-4532-EU (EU entity) for a subset of EU buyer transactions.
- That reattribute caused a VAT pass-through adjustment that shows up as a negative settlement (credit) on the seller-facing invoice.
- The automated correction was triggered by updated VAT registration data AWS ingested for the buyer region; it did not originate from a refund/return.

Attachments: aws_settlement_report_aug2028.csv, seller_mapping_notes.txt

Next steps I propose:
1) Ask AWS for the full audit log for the tax-tag correction (who/what initiated, timestamp).
2) If the correction was correct, confirm with Vantage that their EU entity wants the reattribution; if they do not, AWS can re-run the allocation.
3) Hold payment to Vantage for the disputed amount in a suspense account until we have explicit direction.

I'll coordinate with AWS if you want me to open the case.

- Marissa
Marketplace Operations

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@vantagesystems.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Support <aws-marketplace-support@amazon.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 06 Sep 2028 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Reconciliation update: August credit on your invoice (VG-4532)

Hi Elena,

Thanks for flagging this. Short update from our side after an initial review:
- We see an automated tax-tag reclassification on 2028-08-27 that moved a set of EU buyer charges to your EU seller entity; that explains the VAT pass-through credit on your invoice.
- Marissa has attached the AWS settlement extract and our mapping notes; AWS will need to provide the audit log showing the data that triggered this change.
- We're placing the disputed amount ($28,430) in suspense pending confirmation from you whether you want the EU reattribution to stand. If you want it reversed, we will request AWS re-run allocations and reissue the settlement.

What we need from you to accelerate the case with AWS:
1) Confirmation of whether Vantage approves the EU entity attribution for those transactions.
2) Any VAT registration docs for the VG-4532-EU entity if you want AWS to keep the reattribution.
3) If you do NOT approve, a short note saying you request a reallocation and repayment to the US entity.

I'll keep you posted as AWS Support returns the audit log. Apologies for the disruption right before your board close — we'll prioritize.

Regards,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com

From: AWS Marketplace Support <aws-marketplace-support@amazon.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Morales <elena@vantagesystems.com>
Date: Fri, 08 Sep 2028 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Unexpected marketplace credit applied to August invoice - evidence attached (Case #CASE-20280908-2839)

Hello Hannah and Elena,

Thanks for the details. We reviewed the settlement trace for seller VG-4532. The tax-tag correction was triggered by an update to buyer VAT metadata that AWS received on 2028-08-26 from an upstream tax provider. The automated process reattributed a subset of transactions to VG-4532-EU which created the VAT pass-through credit on the seller invoice.

Case open: CASE-20280908-2839
We can provide the full audit log (timestamps and source payload) and re-run the allocation if Vantage requests a reversal. To proceed we need:
- A confirmation email from the seller (Elena) stating whether they accept the EU reattribution OR request AWS to reverse the allocation.
- If accepting, provide VAT registration for VG-4532-EU.
- If requesting reversal, please indicate the transactions to reassign or request a full re-run for the affected payout window (Aug 2028).

We will hold automated settlement corrections for this seller until the case closes. If you provide the confirmation by end of week, we aim to process within 3 business days after receipt.

Best regards,
AWS Marketplace Support
aws-marketplace-support@amazon.com
https://console.aws.amazon.com/marketplace/management/cases/CASE-20280908-2839
